description: Change the signed-in member's supply cart (the same cart as the website's product pages). action "add" adds qty of a product (product_id from shop_supplies; option is the option's label for a product with options), on top of any already there. "set" sets a product's quantity (0 removes it). "remove" takes a product out. "clear" empties the cart. Nothing is bought or charged. Say what changed and the cart's new total from the result.
name: update_supply_cart
title: Change your supply cart
